_comment: Copy to lab.secrets.local.json in your LAB_HOME (git-ignored) and fill in only what you use. lab/init creates an empty one for you. Values are loaded into environment variables at framework start; an existing session variable always wins, so you can override any of them for a single shell.
LAB_SECRET_MSGAPP: client secret for the Graph app registration
LAB_SECRET_DVERSE: client secret for the Dataverse app - only used by the reserved app-only identity
LAB_SECRET_PBI: client secret for the Power BI app - only used by the reserved app-only identity
LAB_CERT_PASSWORD: password for the SharePoint REST signing certificate (written by lab/setup-app-certificate)
